subject.title: Control UI Dashboard v2 freezes on Chrome 146 (works fine in Firefox)

question: Should the Chrome-specific mitigation require a live current-main repro and trigger removal first, or should OpenClaw add an explicit safe UI fallback for affected Chromium builds?
rationale: The issue is credible, but code inspection cannot safely choose between removing a concrete render trigger, adding compatibility fallback behavior, or waiting for fresh browser proof without maintainer intent.

options.title: Reproduce And Remove Trigger
options.body: Require a current Chrome/Chromium trace first, then remove or simplify the specific shell/layout/render code that causes the lockup.

options.title: Add Safe UI Fallback
options.body: Accept a fallback mode such as a simpler shell for affected Chromium builds or an explicit safe-ui query path, with docs and browser proof.

options.title: Defer Pending Evidence
options.body: Keep the issue open but avoid code changes until someone can reproduce the freeze on current main and identify the failing render phase.

recommendation.title: Reproduce And Remove Trigger
recommendation.body: Require a current Chrome/Chromium trace first, then remove or simplify the specific shell/layout/render code that causes the lockup.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest direct history on Dashboard v2 and the related Control UI responsiveness fixes.
